title: 第27章 大步迈进燕影厂
content_zh:
7月8号下午，刘济民骑着自行车再次来到了《解放军文艺》编辑部。

    昨天电话里，刘济民将《包氏父子》剧本和《归队》小说的情况跟李英简单讲了讲，李英非常感兴趣，希望刘济民到《解放军文艺》编辑部聊一聊。

    再次来到《解放军文艺》编辑部，刘济民骑在自行车上跟门卫打了一个招呼，就直接进去了。

    “好家伙，这小子挺厉害啊，又有新稿子了？”门卫感慨道。

    刘济民快步走到二楼小说组的办公室，李英等人正低头看稿。一个个热得大汗直流，白衬衣黏糊糊地贴在了身上，绿军裤被挽到了小腿上。

    的确良衣服耐磨是耐磨，但是太不透气了。

    李英还是坐在老位置，右手持笔，左手握着蒲扇。他的位置相对好一点，正好在窗户旁边，办公室的门开着，时不时能吹一吹过堂风。

    刘济民轻轻敲了敲门，里面几位编辑立即抬起了头，看到是刘济民后，微微颔首后便继续低头忙了起来。

    “济民同志，来尝尝西瓜，这是昨天燕京军区的一位同志送来的，他们连队自己种的，非常甜。”李英笑着递给刘济民一牙西瓜，“他写了一个短篇，还不错。”

    刘济民看了看空空如也的双手，这老头儿是在这儿点自己的吗？

    接过李英递过来的西瓜，刘济民咬了一口：“是挺甜的，要是有冰箱冰镇一下就好了！”

    “哎呦喂，你可真敢想！”李英自己也拿起一块西瓜咬了一口，果肉连西瓜子一同咽了下去。

    说不定这西瓜子到了明年，还能长成一株西瓜，人称屙瓜。

    李英吃完西瓜之后，迫不及待地接过了刘济民手中的稿子，低头问道：“你写的剧本是什么？”

    “剧本啊，是《包氏父子》，张天翼同志写的，我以前看过这篇小说，觉得对我们的生活非常具有教育意义。为了扩大文章的影响，我就想着把它拍成电影。”

    李英抬头思考片刻，若有所思地说道：“我想起来了，张天翼同志的这篇文章给我的印象很深。济民啊，你的嗅觉挺灵敏嘛！”

    “哈哈哈，还是张天翼同志对社会观察的仔细，我就是再过一遍手。”

    “你不要谦虚，你的写作水平也很高。你坐这里休息会，要是觉得太热，你就去三楼的水房里洗把脸。没办法，我们这里的条件就这样。”李英说道。

    “行！不过《归队》我还没写完，要不您先留着，等我下部送过来再仔细聊。”这里实在太热，刘济民实在不想久待。
content_en:
On the afternoon of July 8, Liu Jimin rode his bicycle to the editorial office of "People's Liberation Army Literature and Art" again.

    On the phone yesterday, Liu Jimin briefly told Li Ying about the situation of the script of "Bao and Sons" and the novel "Return to the Army". Li Ying was very interested and hoped that Liu Jimin would come to the editorial office of "People's Liberation Army Literature and Art" to have a chat.

    When he came to the editorial office of "People's Liberation Army Literature and Art" again, Liu Jimin said hello to the guard on his bicycle and went in directly.

    "Good guy, this guy is really good. Is there any new manuscript?" the guard said with emotion.

    Liu Jimin quickly walked to the novel group's office on the second floor, where Li Ying and others were looking down at the manuscript. They were all sweating profusely from the heat, their white shirts clinging to their bodies in a sticky manner, and their green army pants rolled up to their calves.

    Indeed, good clothes are wear-resistant, but they are too airtight.

    Li Ying was still sitting in his old position, holding a pen in his right hand and a cattail leaf fan in his left hand. His position is relatively better, right next to the window. The door of the office is open, and there is a breeze from time to time.

    Liu Jimin knocked lightly on the door, and several editors inside immediately raised their heads. When they saw it was Liu Jimin, they nodded slightly and continued to work with their heads down.

    "Comrade Jimin, come and try some watermelon. This was sent by a comrade from the Yanjing Military Region yesterday. Their company grew it themselves. It's very sweet." Li Ying smiled and handed Liu Jimin a bite of watermelon. "He wrote a short story, which was pretty good."

    Liu Jimin looked at his empty hands. Is this old man dotting himself here?

    Taking the watermelon handed over by Li Ying, Liu Jimin took a bite: "It's quite sweet. It would be nice if there was a refrigerator to chill it!"

    "Oh, you really dare to think!" Li Ying herself picked up a piece of watermelon and took a bite, swallowing the pulp and seeds together.

    Maybe this watermelon seed will grow into a watermelon next year, which is called a watermelon.

    After Li Ying finished eating the watermelon, she couldn't wait to take the manuscript from Liu Jimin's hand, lowered her head and asked: "What is the script you wrote?"

    "The script is "Bao and Sons", written by Comrade Zhang Tianyi. I have read this novel before and thought it was very educational for our lives. In order to expand the impact of the article, I thought of making it into a movie."

    Li Ying raised her head and thought for a moment, then said thoughtfully: "I remembered, Comrade Zhang Tianyi's article impressed me deeply. Jimin, you have a very sensitive sense of smell!"

    "Hahaha, Comrade Zhang Tianyi is still observing society carefully, I will just go through it again."

    "Don't be modest. Your writing skills are also very high. Sit here and take a rest. If you feel it's too hot, go to the water room on the third floor and wash your face. There's no way, our conditions here are like this." Li Ying said.

    "Okay! But I haven't finished writing "Return to the Team" yet. Why don't you keep it for now and wait for me to send the second part over and then we can talk more about it." It's too hot here, and Liu Jimin really doesn't want to stay too long.
title_en: Chapter 27 Stride towards Yan Film Factory
